text:
Situation: Protamine sulfate is not on the FDA shortage list as of 2026-10-21. The prior shortage first posted on 2021-04-20 has been resolved. Corvale East holds 293 vials (31.1 days at 9.4 vials/day). Corvale General holds 160 vials (14.9 days at 10.7 vials/day).

Why (FDA record): FDA records show protamine sulfate is not currently listed in shortage. The earlier shortage posting date was 2021-04-20. FDA inspection 1123748 ended 2020-05-18, classified OAI, letter dated 2024-05-22. FDA inspection 1174894 ended 2022-06-30, classified OAI, letter dated 2024-04-30. FDA inspection 1216183 ended 2023-08-24, classified VAI.

Our position: Supply is adequate at Corvale East but limited at Corvale General. No active FDA shortage exists. The plant’s most recent inspection (2023-08-24) was VAI.

Recommended actions:
1. Continue standard purchasing for Corvale East; no committee approval required.
2. Expedite a transfer of 100 vials from Corvale East to Corvale General; requires Pharmacy Director approval.
3. Monitor Corvale General daily usage and reorder point; requires Buyer compliance.
4. Report inventory status to P&T committee at next scheduled meeting; requires Buyer completion.

Not recommended: No allocation, rationing, or alternative agent protocols at this time.
